name: Rothwells Running
description: Running and strength coaching from Edinburgh ultra runner Peter Rothwell. Online coaching, 1-1 personal training at Meadowbank, and a weekly run club.

headline: Run further.
Lift stronger.
Go past the wall.
hero.intro: I'm Peter, an ultra marathon runner from Edinburgh. I coach runners and lifters of every level with plans built around your life, your body and the race you're chasing.

about.name: Peter Rothwell
paragraphs: I found fitness in my early twenties and was obsessed almost straight away. A few years later I made it my career. Now I run ultra marathons and coach athletes from every background.
Most of what I teach is about mental fortitude: giving you the tools, the structure and the push to get past the limits you thought you had.

photo.alt: Peter smiling in a climbing helmet on a rocky ledge high in the mountains
